local char, byte, sub = string.char, string.byte, string.sub
local bxor = (bit32 or bit).bxor
local concat, insert = table.concat, table.insert

local function xorDecrypt(p1, p2)
    local t1 = {}
    for i = 1, #p1 do
        insert(t1, char(bxor(byte(sub(p1,i,i+1)), byte(sub(p2, i % #p2 + 1, i % #p2 + 1 + 1))) % 256))
    end
    return concat(t1)
end

-- ─── Find real remote ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function getRealRemote(bucket)
    local remotes = bucket:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
    if not remotes then return nil end

    -- wait for AC to signal remotes are ready
    local n = 0
    repeat task.wait(0.1) ; n += 1
    until remotes:GetAttribute("RemotesReady") or n >= 100

    -- decrypt the attribute key same way the LocalScript does
    local attrName = xorDecrypt("\226\218\213&Ͽ", "~\177\163\187E\134ۧ")
    local remoteName = bucket:GetAttribute(attrName)

    if remoteName then
        local remote = remotes:FindFirstChild(remoteName)
        if remote then
            print("[olliE] real remote found:", remoteName)
            return remote
        end
    end

    print("[olliE] attribute decrypt failed, dumping all attributes:")
    for k, v in pairs(bucket:GetAttributes()) do

    return nil

    for i, info in pairs(provinces) do

            info.Event:Disconnect()

    for _, info in pairs(provinces) do

        or input == dragInput then

            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

        or input == dragInput then

local function findFocusedBox()
    for _, object in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
        if object:IsA("TextBox")
            and object.Visible
            and object:IsFocused() then

            return object
        end
    end

    return nil
end

-- TYPE COUNTRIES
local function runSequence()
    if typing then return end

    typing = true
    local mySession = session

    task.spawn(function()
        while enabled and mySession == session do

            local box = activeBox

            if not box or not box.Parent then
                box = findFocusedBox()
                activeBox = box
            end

            if box and box:IsFocused() then

                local country = countries[index]

                if not country then
                    enabled = false
                    status.Text = "Status: FINISHED!"
                    break
                end

                -- Set text in an authorized TextBox
                box.Text = country

                -- Submit through Roblox's supported TextBox API.
                -- FocusLost receives enterPressed = true.
                box:ReleaseFocus(true)

                index += 1

                progress.Text =
                    "Countries: " .. (index - 1) .. " / " .. #countries

                if index > #countries then
                    enabled = false
                    status.Text = "Status: FINISHED!"
                    status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 130)
                    break
                end

                task.wait(COOLDOWN)

                -- Resume only if the same textbox still exists.
                if enabled and mySession == session
                    and box.Parent then
                    activeBox = box
                    box:CaptureFocus()
                end

            else
                activeBox = findFocusedBox()
                task.wait(0.1)
            end
        end

        typing = false
    end)
end

-- START
startButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if enabled then return end

    enabled = true
    session += 1

    status.Text = "Status: WAITING FOR TEXTBOX"
    status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 80)

    activeBox = findFocusedBox()
    runSequence()
end)

-- REPEAT
repeatButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    enabled = false
    session += 1
    index = 1
    activeBox = nil

    progress.Text = "Countries: 0 / " .. #countries

    task.wait(0.1)

    enabled = true
    status.Text = "Status: RESTARTING"
    status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 180, 255)

    activeBox = findFocusedBox()
    runSequence()
end)

-- STOP
stopButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    enabled = false
    session += 1
    activeBox = nil

    status.Text = "Status: STOPPED"
    status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
end)

print("Name Every Country loaded!")
print("Total countries:", #countries)

local Players    = game:GetService("Players")
local RS         = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local WS         = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UIS        = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LP         = Players.LocalPlayer

local C = {
    baseRange = 20,
    maxRange  = 100,
    safetyT   = 0.16,
    baseClick = 4,
    maxClick  = 16,
    clickScl  = 0.03,
    dot       = 0.1,
    panic     = 5,
    key       = Enum.KeyCode.E,
}

local function getRemote()
    local r = RS:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    if r then
        for _, n in ipairs({"Deflect","ReqDef","Parry","Block"}) do
            local o = r:FindFirstChild(n)
            if o and o:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return o end
        end
    end
    for _, d in ipairs(RS:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            local s = d.Name:lower()
            if s:find("deflect") or s:find("reqdef") or s:find("parr") then
                return d
            end
        end
    end
end

local parry = getRemote()

local hmc  = typeof(mouse1click) == "function"
local hmp  = typeof(mouse1press) == "function" and typeof(mouse1release) == "function"
local hma  = typeof(mousemoveabs) == "function"
local hmr  = typeof(mousemoverel) == "function"
local hkp  = typeof(keypress) == "function"
local hkr  = typeof(keyrelease) == "function"

local mon = {
    spd = 0,
    rng = C.baseRange,
    clk = C.baseClick,
    dst = math.huge,
    app = false,
}

local mPos, mTick = nil, nil
local smoothSpd = 0

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.05)

        local ball = WS:FindFirstChild("GameBall")
        local char = LP.Character
        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if not ball or not ball:IsA("BasePart") or not root then
            mPos, mTick = nil, nil
            smoothSpd = 0
            mon.spd = 0
            mon.rng = C.baseRange
            mon.clk = C.baseClick
            mon.dst = math.huge
            mon.app = false
            continue
        end

        local now  = tick()
        local bp   = ball.Position
        local rp   = root.Position
        local vec  = bp - rp
        local dist = vec.Magnitude

        local app = false
        local inst = 0

        if mPos and mTick then
            local dt = now - mTick
            if dt > 0.001 then
                local dv = bp - mPos
                inst = dv.Magnitude / dt
                if dv.Magnitude > 0.05 and dist > 0.1 then
                    app = -(vec.Unit):Dot(dv.Unit) > C.dot
                end
            end
        end

        mPos, mTick = bp, now
        smoothSpd = smoothSpd * 0.7 + inst * 0.3

        local rng = smoothSpd * C.safetyT
        if rng < C.baseRange then rng = C.baseRange end
        if rng > C.maxRange  then rng = C.maxRange  end

        local clk = math.floor(C.baseClick + smoothSpd * C.clickScl + 0.5)
        if clk < C.baseClick then clk = C.baseClick end
        if clk > C.maxClick  then clk = C.maxClick  end

        mon.spd = smoothSpd
        mon.rng = rng
        mon.clk = clk
        mon.dst = dist
        mon.app = app
    end
end)

local function isRed()
    local char = LP.Character
    if char then
        local hl = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Highlight")
        if hl and hl.Enabled then return true end
        for _, a in ipairs({"isTarget","Targeted","isTargeted","HasBall","IsTarget"}) do
            if char:GetAttribute(a) == true then return true end
        end
    end
    local phl = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Highlight")
    if phl and phl.Enabled then return true end
    for _, a in ipairs({"isTarget","Targeted","isTargeted","HasBall","IsTarget"}) do
        if LP:GetAttribute(a) == true then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function fireOne()
    if parry then
        pcall(function() parry:FireServer() end)
    end

    if hkp then
        pcall(keypress, C.key)
        if hkr then
            task.delay(0.003, function() pcall(keyrelease, C.key) end)
        end
    end

    local cam  = WS.CurrentCamera
    local ball = WS:FindFirstChild("GameBall")

    if cam and ball and ball:IsA("BasePart") then
        local sp, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(ball.Position)
        if on then
            if hma then
                pcall(mousemoveabs, math.floor(sp.X), math.floor(sp.Y))
            elseif hmr then
                local cur = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
                pcall(mousemoverel, math.floor(sp.X - cur.X), math.floor(sp.Y - cur.Y))
            end
        end
    end

    if hmp then
        pcall(mouse1press)
        task.delay(0.003, function() pcall(mouse1release) end)
    elseif hmc then
        pcall(mouse1click)
    end
end

local locked = false

local function lockMove(s)
    if s == locked then return end
    locked = s

    local char = LP.Character
    local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end

    if s then
        pcall(function()
            hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
            hum.WalkSpeed = 0
            hum.JumpPower = 0
        end)
    else
        pcall(function()
            hum.WalkSpeed = 16
            hum.JumpPower = 50
        end)
    end
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local char = LP.Character
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then lockMove(false); return end

    if mon.dst == math.huge then lockMove(false); return end

    local hit = mon.dst <= mon.rng and mon.app and isRed()
    local pnk = mon.dst <= C.panic

    if not (hit or pnk) then
        lockMove(false)
        return
    end

    lockMove(true)

    local n = pnk and mon.clk * 2 or mon.clk
    for _ = 1, n do
        fireOne()
    end
end)

LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    lockMove(false)
end)

local function createOption(name, stateKey, layoutOrder, callback)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_OFF
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	btn.TextSize = 16
	btn.ZIndex = 3
	btn.Text = name .. ": OFF"
	btn.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder
	btn.Parent = scrollFrame
	applyClickSound(btn)

	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		states[stateKey] = not states[stateKey]
		if states[stateKey] then
			btn.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_ON
			btn.Text = name .. ": ON"
			table.insert(activeColorButtons, btn)
			playActivationGlow(true)
		else
			btn.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_OFF
			btn.Text = name .. ": OFF"
			playActivationGlow(false)
		end
		if callback then callback(states[stateKey]) end
	end)
	return btn
end

createOption("Fly Mode", "Fly", 1, function(enabled)
	local char = player.Character
	if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
	local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if enabled then
		hum.PlatformStand = true
		if flyBodyVelocity then flyBodyVelocity:Destroy() end
		if flyBodyGyro then flyBodyGyro:Destroy() end

		flyBodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		flyBodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
		flyBodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		flyBodyVelocity.Parent = hrp

		flyBodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
		flyBodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
		flyBodyGyro.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
		flyBodyGyro.Parent = hrp
	else
		hum.PlatformStand = false
		if flyBodyVelocity then flyBodyVelocity:Destroy() flyBodyVelocity = nil end
		if flyBodyGyro then flyBodyGyro:Destroy() flyBodyGyro = nil end
	end
end)

createOption("Anti-Kick", "AntiKick", 6, function(enabled)
	if enabled then
		pcall(function()
			local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
			setreadonly(mt, false)
			local old = mt.__namecall
			mt.__namecall = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
				local method = getnamecallmethod()
				if method == "Kick" and self == player and states.AntiKick then
					return
				end
				return old(self, ...)
			end)
			setreadonly(mt, true)
		end)
	end
end)

local customSound = nil
local savedMusicTime = 0
local currentSongTitle = playlist[1].name

local function getSongNameById(id)
	for _, item in ipairs(playlist) do
		if item.id == id then return item.name end
	end
	return "Custom Track (" .. id .. ")"
end

local function playSelectedSound(soundId, songName)
	if not customSound or not customSound.Parent then
		if customSound then customSound:Destroy() end
		customSound = Instance.new("Sound")
		customSound.Name = "CustomMusicPlayer"
		customSound.Looped = true
		customSound.Parent = SoundService
	end
	
	local fullAssetId = "rbxassetid://" .. soundId
	customSound.Volume = math.clamp(musicVolumeValue, 0.05, 10)
	currentSongTitle = songName
	
	if customSound.SoundId ~= fullAssetId then
		savedMusicTime = 0
		customSound.SoundId = fullAssetId
		customSound.TimePosition = 0
		customSound:Play()
	else
		customSound.TimePosition = savedMusicTime
		customSound:Play()
	end

	musicStatusLabel.Text = "🎵 Playing: " .. currentSongTitle
end

musicBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	states.Music = not states.Music
	if states.Music then
		musicBtn.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_ON
		table.insert(activeColorButtons, musicBtn)
		musicBtn.Text = "Stop Music"
		playActivationGlow(true)
		local soundId = tonumber(musicBox.Text) or playlist[1].id
		musicVolumeValue = tonumber(volBox.Text) or 1
		playSelectedSound(soundId, getSongNameById(soundId))
	else
		musicBtn.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_OFF
		musicBtn.Text = "Play Music"
		playActivationGlow(false)
		if customSound then
			savedMusicTime = customSound.TimePosition
			customSound:Pause()
		end
		musicStatusLabel.Text = "🎵 Music: Paused"
	end
end)

nextMusicBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	currentPlaylistIndex = currentPlaylistIndex + 1
	if currentPlaylistIndex > #playlist then currentPlaylistIndex = 1 end
	local currentSong = playlist[currentPlaylistIndex]
	musicBox.Text = tostring(currentSong.id)
	savedMusicTime = 0
	playActivationGlow(true)
	if states.Music then
		playSelectedSound(currentSong.id, currentSong.name)
	else
		currentSongTitle = currentSong.name
		if customSound then
			customSound:Stop()
			customSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. currentSong.id
			customSound.TimePosition = 0
		end
	end
end)

volBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
	musicVolumeValue = tonumber(volBox.Text) or 1
	if customSound then customSound.Volume = math.clamp(musicVolumeValue, 0.05, 10) end
end)

local function updateESP()
	if not states.ESP then return end
	local myChar = player.Character
	local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local activeNames = {}
	
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p ~= player and p.Character then
			local char = p.Character
			local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local rootPart = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			
			if head and rootPart and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
				activeNames[p.Name] = true
				
				local hl = char:FindFirstChild("KM_ESP_Highlight")
				if not hl then
					hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
					hl.Name = "KM_ESP_Highlight"
					hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
					hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
					hl.FillTransparency = 0.55
					hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
					hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
					hl.Adornee = char
					hl.Parent = char
				end
				
				local boxTag = "ESP_Box_" .. p.Name
				local boxAdornee = espFolder:FindFirstChild(boxTag)
				if not boxAdornee then
					boxAdornee = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
					boxAdornee.Name = boxTag
					boxAdornee.Adornee = char
					boxAdornee.AlwaysOnTop = true
					boxAdornee.ZIndex = 5
					boxAdornee.Size = char:GetExtentsSize()
					boxAdornee.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
					boxAdornee.Transparency = 0.6
					boxAdornee.Parent = espFolder
				else
					boxAdornee.Size = char:GetExtentsSize()
				end

				local distance = myRoot and math.floor((rootPart.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude) or 0
				local tagName = "ESP_Text_" .. p.Name
				local billboard = espFolder:FindFirstChild(tagName)
				
				if not billboard then
					billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
					billboard.Name = tagName
					billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 40)
					billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)
					billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
					
					local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
					textLabel.Name = "InfoLabel"
					textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
					textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
					textLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
					textLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
					textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
					textLabel.TextSize = 14
					textLabel.Parent = billboard
					
					billboard.Parent = espFolder
				end
				
				billboard.Adornee = head
				local lbl = billboard:FindFirstChild("InfoLabel")
				if lbl then
					lbl.Text = p.Name .. " | HP: " .. math.floor(hum.Health) .. " | " .. distance .. "m"
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	for _, child in ipairs(espFolder:GetChildren()) do
		local targetName = string.gsub(child.Name, "^ESP_Text_", "")
		targetName = string.gsub(targetName, "^ESP_Box_", "")
		if not activeNames[targetName] then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		if draggingFOV then
			local pos = input.Position.X
			local absPos = cameraFrame.AbsolutePosition.X
			local absSize = cameraFrame.AbsoluteSize.X
			local relX = math.clamp((pos - absPos) / absSize, 0, 1)

			fovValue = math.floor(30 + (relX * 90))
			local percent = math.floor((fovValue / 120) * 100)

			camera.FieldOfView = fovValue
		elseif draggingSpin then
			local pos = input.Position.X
			local absPos = spinFrame.AbsolutePosition.X
			local absSize = spinFrame.AbsoluteSize.X
			local relX = math.clamp((pos - absPos) / absSize, 0, 1)
			spinFill.Size = UDim2.new(relX, 0, 1, 0)
			spinSpeed = math.floor(relX * 100)
			spinLabel.Text = "SpinBot: " .. spinSpeed .. " (" .. spinSpeed .. "%)"
		elseif draggingWalkSpeed then
			local pos = input.Position.X
			local absPos = walkSpeedFrame.AbsolutePosition.X
			local absSize = walkSpeedFrame.AbsoluteSize.X
			local relX = math.clamp((pos - absPos) / absSize, 0, 1)
			walkSpeedFill.Size = UDim2.new(relX, 0, 1, 0)
			speedValue = math.floor(16 + (relX * 334))
			local percent = math.floor(relX * 100)
			walkSpeedLabel.Text = "WalkSpeed: " .. speedValue .. " (" .. percent .. "%)"
		elseif draggingJumpPower then
			local pos = input.Position.X
			local absPos = jumpPowerFrame.AbsolutePosition.X
			local absSize = jumpPowerFrame.AbsoluteSize.X
			local relX = math.clamp((pos - absPos) / absSize, 0, 1)
			jumpPowerFill.Size = UDim2.new(relX, 0, 1, 0)
			jumpPowerValue = math.floor(50 + (relX * 300))

			jumpPowerLabel.Text = "JumpPower: " .. jumpPowerValue .. " (" .. percent .. "%)"

	end

local soundSpamTimer = 0
local fpsUpdateTimer = 0

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	frameCount = frameCount + 1
	fpsUpdateTimer = fpsUpdateTimer + deltaTime
	if fpsUpdateTimer >= 0.5 then
		local fps = math.floor(frameCount / fpsUpdateTimer)
		local ping = 0
		pcall(function()
			ping = math.floor(Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue())
		end)
		fpsPingLabel.Text = "FPS: " .. fps .. " | Ping: " .. ping .. "ms"
		frameCount = 0
		fpsUpdateTimer = 0
	end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
		local hum = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not states.CFrameWalk then
			hum.WalkSpeed = speedValue
		end
		hum.JumpPower = jumpPowerValue
		
		if states.SwimAir then
			pcall(function()
				hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming)
			end)
		end
	end
	
	if states.FPSUnlocker and setfpscap then setfpscap(999) end
	
	if states.NoClip and player.Character then
		for _, part in ipairs(player.Character:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
		end
	end
	
	if states.ESP then updateESP() end
	
	if states.ChatSpammer then
		spamTimerMain = spamTimerMain + deltaTime
		if spamTimerMain >= spamInterval then
			spamTimerMain = 0
			pcall(function()
				if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
					local channel = TextChatService.TextChannels.RBXGeneral
					if channel then channel:SendAsync(spamText) end
				else
					ReplicatedStorage.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(spamText, "All")
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	
	if states.SoundSpammer then
		soundSpamTimer = soundSpamTimer + deltaTime
		if soundSpamTimer >= 3.0 then
			soundSpamTimer = 0
			pcall(function()
				local sId = playlist[selectedSpamIndex].id
				local spamSnd = Instance.new("Sound")
				spamSnd.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. sId
				spamSnd.Volume = 10
				spamSnd.Parent = SoundService
				spamSnd:Play()
				task.delay(3, function() if spamSnd then spamSnd:Destroy() end end)
			end)
		end
	end

	if states.Godmode and player.Character then
		local hum = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then hum.MaxHealth = math.huge hum.Health = math.huge end
	end
	
	if states.WalkOnWater and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		local root = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
		if not waterPlatform or not waterPlatform.Parent then
			waterPlatform = Instance.new("Part")
			waterPlatform.Name = "WaterPlatformKM"
			waterPlatform.Size = Vector3.new(6, 1, 6)
			waterPlatform.Anchored = true
			waterPlatform.Transparency = 0.7
			waterPlatform.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Cyan")
			waterPlatform.Parent = Workspace
		end
		waterPlatform.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position.X, root.Position.Y - 3.5, root.Position.Z)
	else
		if waterPlatform and waterPlatform.Parent then waterPlatform:Destroy() waterPlatform = nil end
	end
	
	if states.AntiRagdoll and player.Character then
		local hum = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then
			pcall(function()
				hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false)
				hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, false)
			end)
		end
	end
	
	if states.HitboxExpander then
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if p ~= player and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
				local hrp = p.Character.HumanoidRootPart
				hrp.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
				hrp.Transparency = 0.7
				hrp.CanCollide = false
			end
		end
	end
	
	if states.Fly and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		local hum = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then hum.PlatformStand = true end
		
		if flyBodyVelocity and flyBodyGyro then
			local camCF = camera.CFrame
			local moveDir = hum.MoveDirection
			
			local velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
			if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
				local lookVector = camCF.LookVector
				local rightVector = camCF.RightVector
				
				local flyDir = (rightVector * moveDir.X + Vector3.new(lookVector.X, 0, lookVector.Z).Unit * -moveDir.Z)
				if flyDir.Magnitude > 0 then
					velocity = flyDir.Unit * flySpeed
				end
			end
			
			flyBodyVelocity.Velocity = velocity
			flyBodyGyro.CFrame = camCF
		end
	end

	if camera then camera.FieldOfView = fovValue end

	if spinSpeed > 0 and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		local root = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
		root.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(spinSpeed * 20 * deltaTime), 0)
	end

	local isPlayingMusic = states.Music and customSound and customSound.IsPlaying
	if isPlayingMusic then
		local volMultiplier = math.clamp(musicVolumeValue, 0.2, 3)
		for i = 1, #bottomAudioBars do
			local barInfo = bottomAudioBars[i]
			barInfo.timer = barInfo.timer + (deltaTime * barInfo.speed)
			local waveHeight = math.floor((110 + (math.sin(barInfo.timer + (i * 0.5)) * 95)) * volMultiplier)
			barInfo.frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, math.clamp(waveHeight, 20, 300))
		end
	end

	if states.RainbowSkin and player.Character then
		local hue = tick() % 5 / 5
		local rainbowColor = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
		for _, part in ipairs(player.Character:GetChildren()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.Color = rainbowColor end
		end
	end
	
	if states.RainbowMap and not states.Fullbright then
		Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromHSV(tick() % 5 / 5, 1, 1)
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromHSV((tick() + 2.5) % 5 / 5, 1, 1)
	end
end)

--[[
    ██  SPAWNPOINT  ██
    Delta Executor (Android) — spawn-point themed utility panel
    Single file. Paste, execute, done.
    Mobile-first: drag header, big toggles, on-screen fly pad.
]]

local Players       = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService    = game:GetService("RunService")

local TweenService  = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Teleport      = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local StarterGui    = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local HttpService   = game:GetService("HttpService")

local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- ============ PALETTE ============
local C = {
    bg     = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 12),
    panel  = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 17),
    row    = Color3.fromRGB(21, 21, 26),
    stroke = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 38),
    text   = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245),
    muted  = Color3.fromRGB(99, 99, 110),
    accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
}

local function notify(txt)
    pcall(StarterGui.SetCore, StarterGui, "SendNotification", {
        Title = "SPAWNPOINT", Text = txt, Duration = 2,
    })
end

-- wipe previous instance
local existing = game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("SpawnPointUI")
if existing then existing:Destroy() end

-- ============ ROOT ============
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "SpawnPointUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

if not gui.Parent then gui.Parent = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end

-- ============ STAR LOGO (procedural, mirrors the spawn icon) ============
local function buildStar(parent, px)
    local chip = Instance.new("Frame")
    chip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(px, px)
    chip.BackgroundColor3 = C.accent
    chip.BorderSizePixel = 0
    chip.Parent = parent
    Instance.new("UICorner", chip).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
    holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    holder.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
    holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
    holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    holder.Parent = chip

    local outer, inner = px * 0.44, px * 0.20
    local widths = { 0.30, 0.22, 0.145, 0.065 }

    for i = 0, 7 do
        local spoke = Instance.new("Frame")
        spoke.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        spoke.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
        spoke.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
        spoke.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        spoke.Rotation = i * 45
        spoke.Parent = holder

        local segLen = (outer - inner) / 4 + 1
        for s = 1, 4 do
            local seg = Instance.new("Frame")
            seg.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
            seg.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, inner + (s - 1) * (outer - inner) / 4)
            seg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(px * widths[s], segLen)
            seg.BackgroundColor3 = C.bg
            seg.BorderSizePixel = 0
            seg.Parent = spoke
        end
    end

    local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
    ring.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    ring.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
    ring.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(inner * 2, inner * 2)
    ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    ring.Parent = chip
    Instance.new("UICorner", ring).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local rs = Instance.new("UIStroke", ring)
    rs.Color = C.bg
    rs.Thickness = math.max(2, px * 0.058)

    -- slow idle spin
    task.spawn(function()
        while chip.Parent do
            local t = TweenService:Create(holder, TweenInfo.new(16, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
                Rotation = holder.Rotation + 360,
            })
            t:Play(); t.Completed:Wait()
            holder.Rotation = holder.Rotation % 360
        end
    end)
    return chip
end

local function toggle(label, hint, default, callback)
    local r = row(label, hint)
    local sw = Instance.new("Frame")
    sw.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
    sw.Position = UDim2.new(1, -11, 0.5, 0)
    sw.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 20)
    sw.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 44)
    sw.BorderSizePixel = 0
    sw.Parent = r
    Instance.new("UICorner", sw).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2)
    knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(138, 138, 148)
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.Parent = sw
    Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local state = default or false
    local function paint()
        TweenService:Create(sw, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
            BackgroundColor3 = state and C.accent or Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 44),
        }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(knob, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
            Position = state and UDim2.fromOffset(18, 2) or UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2),
            BackgroundColor3 = state and C.bg or Color3.fromRGB(138, 138, 148),
        }):Play()
    end

    local function set(v)
        state = v
        paint()
        task.spawn(function() pcall(callback, v) end)
    end

    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    btn.Text = ""
    btn.Parent = r
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() set(not state) end)

    if state then paint() ; task.spawn(function() pcall(callback, true) end) end
    return set
end

local function slider(label, min, max, default, callback)
    local f = Instance.new("Frame")
    f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
    f.BackgroundColor3 = C.row
    f.BorderSizePixel = 0
    f.Parent = body
    Instance.new("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke", f)
    s.Color = C.stroke; s.Thickness = 1

    local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    t.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(11, 6)
    t.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 13)
    t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    t.Text = label
    t.TextSize = 11
    t.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(217, 217, 224)
    t.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    t.Parent = f

    local val = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    val.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
    val.Position = UDim2.new(1, -11, 0, 6)
    val.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 13)
    val.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    val.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    val.Text = tostring(default)
    val.TextSize = 10
    val.TextColor3 = C.accent
    val.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    val.Parent = f

    local track = Instance.new("Frame")
    track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(11, 30)
    track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 3)
    track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 43, 51)
    track.BorderSizePixel = 0
    track.Parent = f
    Instance.new("UICorner", track).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.new((default - min) / (max - min), 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = C.accent
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Parent = track
    Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new((default - min) / (max - min), 0, 0.5, 0)
    knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 13)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = C.accent
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.Parent = track
    Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local current = default
    local dragging = false

    local function apply(x)
        local rel = math.clamp((x - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / track.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        current = math.floor(min + rel * (max - min) + 0.5)
        val.Text = tostring(current)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 1, 0)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 0.5, 0)
        pcall(callback, current)
    end

    track.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging = true
            apply(i.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if dragging and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
            apply(i.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end
    end)

    pcall(callback, current)
    return function(v)
        local rel = (v - min) / (max - min)
        current = v
        val.Text = tostring(v)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 1, 0)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 0.5, 0)
    end
end

-- ---------- FLY ----------
local held = { f = false, b = false, l = false, r = false, u = false, d = false }
local flyPos

local function stopFly()
    state.flying = false
    local _, _, hrp = char()
    if hrp then
        for _, n in ipairs({ "SP_Att", "SP_AP", "SP_AO" }) do
            local o = hrp:FindFirstChild(n); if o then o:Destroy() end
        end
    end
    flyPos = nil
end

local function startFly()
    local _, hum, hrp = char()
    if not hrp then return notify("No character") end
    stopFly()
    state.flying = true
    hum.PlatformStand = true

    local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
    att.Name = "SP_Att"
    att.Parent = hrp

    local ap = Instance.new("AlignPosition")
    ap.Name = "SP_AP"
    ap.Attachment0 = att
    ap.Mode = Enum.PositionAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
    ap.MaxForce = 1e7
    ap.Responsiveness = 30
    ap.Position = hrp.Position
    ap.Parent = hrp

    local ao = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
    ao.Name = "SP_AO"
    ao.Attachment0 = att
    ao.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
    ao.MaxTorque = 1e7
    ao.Responsiveness = 30
    ao.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position) * (cam.CFrame - cam.CFrame.Position)
    ao.Parent = hrp

    flyPos = hrp.Position
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if not state.flying then return end
    local _, _, hrp = char()
    if not hrp then return end
    local ap = hrp:FindFirstChild("SP_AP")
    local ao = hrp:FindFirstChild("SP_AO")
    if not ap or not ao then return end

    local dir = Vector3.zero
    local look, right = cam.CFrame.LookVector, cam.CFrame.RightVector
    if held.f then dir += look end
    if held.b then dir -= look end
    if held.r then dir += right end
    if held.l then dir -= right end
    if held.u then dir += Vector3.yAxis end
    if held.d then dir -= Vector3.yAxis end
    if dir.Magnitude > 0 then dir = dir.Unit end

    flyPos = (flyPos or hrp.Position) + dir * state.flySpeed * dt
    ap.Position = flyPos
    ao.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z))
end)

toggle("Fly", "Camera-relative, on-screen pad", false, function(on)
    if on then startFly() else stopFly() end
end)

slider("Fly Speed", 10, 300, 70, function(v) state.flySpeed = v end)

section("TELEPORT")

local function tpTo(cf)
    local _, _, hrp = char()
    if not hrp then return end
    hrp.CFrame = cf
    if state.flying then flyPos = cf.Position end
end

button("TP TO AIM (crosshair ray)", false, function()
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { lp.Character }
    local vp = cam.ViewportSize
    local ray = cam:ViewportPointToRay(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)
    local hit = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 1000, params)
    if hit then
        tpTo(CFrame.new(hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)))
        notify("Teleported to surface")
    else
        tpTo(CFrame.new(ray.Origin + ray.Direction * 200))
        notify("Teleported forward")
    end
end)

button("TP TO NEAREST SPAWN", false, function()
    local best, dist
    for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("SpawnLocation") then
            local _, _, hrp = char()
            local dd = hrp and (d.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude or 0
            if not dist or dd < dist then best, dist = d, dd end
        end
    end
    if best then
        tpTo(best.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
        notify("Returned to spawn")
    else
        notify("No SpawnLocation found")
    end
end)

        -- Pega os vetores da câmera, achatados no chão (Y=0)
        local f = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z).Unit
        local r = Vector3.new(cf.RightVector.X, 0, cf.RightVector.Z).Unit
        
        -- Calcula o vetor final de movimento (direção que o dedo puxa)
        -- -dir.Z é usado porque no UI, subir é negativo.
        local wd = (f * -dir.Z) + (r * dir.X)
        
        if wd.Magnitude > 0 then
            wd = wd.Unit
            -- Força o Roblox a girar o boneco para a direção do movimento
            hu.AutoRotate = true
            -- Aplica o movimento nativo (faz a animação funcionar e respeita as paredes)
            hu:Move(wd, false)
        end
    else
        -- Se soltar o dedo, manda parar
        hu:Move(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), false)
    end

-- Variáveis de controle
local flying = false
local noclipping = false

local currentCrate = nil

-- Lógica do Fly
flyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    flying = not flying
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then return end

    if flying then
        flyBtn.Text = "FLY: LIGADO"
        flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
        humanoid.PlatformStand = true

        bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
        bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        bodyVelocity.Parent = rootPart

        bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
        bodyGyro.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame
        bodyGyro.Parent = rootPart
    else
        flyBtn.Text = "FLY: DESLIGADO"
        flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 70)
        humanoid.PlatformStand = false
        if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() end
        if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() end
    end
end)

-- Loop de Movimentação do Fly
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if flying then
        local character = player.Character
        if not character then return end
        local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not rootPart or not bodyVelocity or not bodyGyro then return end

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local moveDir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            moveDir = moveDir + camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            moveDir = moveDir - camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            moveDir = moveDir + camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            moveDir = moveDir - camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            moveDir = moveDir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
            moveDir = moveDir - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end

        bodyVelocity.Velocity = moveDir * flySpeed
        bodyGyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame
    end
end)

    noclipping = not noclipping

                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

baseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local tycoonDirectory = Workspace:FindFirstChild("TycoonDirectory")
    if tycoonDirectory then
        local targetTycoonName = username .. "_Tycoon"
        local tycoonModel = tycoonDirectory:FindFirstChild(targetTycoonName)
        
        if tycoonModel then
            local basicCollector = tycoonModel:FindFirstChild("BasicCollector")
            if basicCollector then
                local character = player.Character
                if character then
                    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if rootPart then
                        rootPart.CFrame = basicCollector:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Função que atualiza o estado dinâmico da Crate
local function updateCrateState()
    local debrisFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Debris")
    local foundCrate = nil
    
    if debrisFolder then
        for _, child in ipairs(debrisFolder:GetChildren()) do
            if child.Name == "Crate" then
                foundCrate = child
                break
            end
        end
    end
    
    currentCrate = foundCrate
    
    if currentCrate then
        teleportBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
        teleportBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        teleportBtn.Active = true
        statusLabel.Text = "Status: Crate Spawnada ✔"
        statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
    else
        teleportBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 70)
        teleportBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 160)
        teleportBtn.Active = false
        statusLabel.Text = "Status: Crate não spawnada ❌"
        statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(231, 76, 60)
    end
end

-- Ação do Botão de Teleporte para a Crate
teleportBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if currentCrate and currentCrate.Parent and teleportBtn.Active then
        local character = player.Character
        if character then
            local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if rootPart then
                rootPart.CFrame = currentCrate:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Lógica de Minimizar o Painel
local minimized = false
local normalSize = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 235)
local minSize = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 40)

minBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    minimized = not minimized
    if minimized then
        contentContainer.Visible = false
        TweenService:Create(mainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {Size = minSize}):Play()
        minBtn.Text = "+"
    else
        TweenService:Create(mainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {Size = normalSize}):Play()
        task.wait(0.1)
        contentContainer.Visible = true
        minBtn.Text = "-"
    end
end)

-- Lógica de Fechar (Abre a confirmação)
closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    modalOverlay.Visible = true
end)

simBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    screenGui:Destroy()
end)

naoBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    modalOverlay.Visible = false
end)

-- Monitoramento automático da pasta Debris
local debrisFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Debris")
if debrisFolder then
    debrisFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if child.Name == "Crate" then
            updateCrateState()
        end
    end)
    
    debrisFolder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
        if child.Name == "Crate" then
            updateCrateState()
        end
    end)
end

-- Checagem inicial
updateCrateState()

-- ================= SUFFIX-Ui Library & Example Bundle =================
local SUFFIX = {}
SUFFIX.__index = SUFFIX

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

function SUFFIX:CreateWindow(config)
    config = config or {}
    local windowTitle = config.Title or "SUFFIX-Ui"

    local self = setmetatable({}, SUFFIX)

    -- Create ScreenGui
    local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    ScreenGui.Name = "SUFFIX_UI_Library"
    ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui

    -- Main Window Box (430 x 260)
    local Box = Instance.new("Frame")
    Box.Name = "SUFFIXBox"
    Box.Size = UDim2.new(0, 430, 0, 260)
    Box.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -215, 0.5, -130)
    Box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
    Box.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Box.Parent = ScreenGui

    local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    UICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    UICorner.Parent = Box

    local UIStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
    UIStroke.Thickness = 1
    UIStroke.Parent = Box

    -- Top Header Bar & Drag System
    local TopBar = Instance.new("Frame")
    TopBar.Name = "TopBar"
    TopBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
    TopBar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    TopBar.Parent = Box

    local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
    TopBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = Box.Position
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    TopBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragInput = input
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput and dragging then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            Box.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end
    end)

    -- Title Label
    local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    Title.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 1, 0)
    Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
    Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Title.Text = windowTitle
    Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    Title.TextSize = 15
    Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    Title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    Title.Parent = TopBar

    local SubTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    SubTitle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 1, 0)
    SubTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 85, 0, 0)
    SubTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    SubTitle.Text = "|  Library"
    SubTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140)
    SubTitle.TextSize = 12
    SubTitle.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    SubTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    SubTitle.Parent = TopBar

    -- Minimize Button (-)
    local MinimizeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    MinimizeButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 26)
    MinimizeButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
    MinimizeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0)
    MinimizeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28)
    MinimizeButton.Text = "-"
    MinimizeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    MinimizeButton.TextSize = 16
    MinimizeButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    MinimizeButton.Parent = TopBar

    local MinButtonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    MinButtonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    MinButtonCorner.Parent = MinimizeButton

    local HeaderLine = Instance.new("Frame")
    HeaderLine.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
    HeaderLine.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    HeaderLine.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    HeaderLine.BackgroundTransparency = 0.75
    HeaderLine.BorderSizePixel = 0
    HeaderLine.Parent = TopBar

    -- Content Main Container
    local ContentMain = Instance.new("Frame")
    ContentMain.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -36)
    ContentMain.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 36)
    ContentMain.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    ContentMain.Parent = Box

    local isMinimized = false
    MinimizeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        isMinimized = not isMinimized
        if isMinimized then
            ContentMain.Visible = false
            Box:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0, 430, 0, 36), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.15, true)
            MinimizeButton.Text = "+"
        else
            Box:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0, 430, 0, 260), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.15, true)
            task.wait(0.1)
            ContentMain.Visible = true
            MinimizeButton.Text = "-"
        end
    end)

    -- Icon Sidebar Layout
    local SIDEBAR_WIDTH = 46
    local TabSidebar = Instance.new("Frame")
    TabSidebar.Size = UDim2.new(0, SIDEBAR_WIDTH, 1, 0)
    TabSidebar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    TabSidebar.Parent = ContentMain

    local TabLine = Instance.new("Frame")
    TabLine.Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0)
    TabLine.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
    TabLine.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    TabLine.BackgroundTransparency = 0.75
    TabLine.BorderSizePixel = 0
    TabLine.Parent = TabSidebar

    local TabList = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    TabList.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -8)
    TabList.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 4)
    TabList.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    TabList.BorderSizePixel = 0
    TabList.ScrollBarThickness = 0
    TabList.Parent = TabSidebar

    local TabListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    TabListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    TabListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
    TabListLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
    TabListLayout.Parent = TabList

    local TabListPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    TabListPadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
    TabListPadding.Parent = TabList

    -- Content Area (Right Side)
    local ContentArea = Instance.new("Frame")
    ContentArea.Size = UDim2.new(1, -SIDEBAR_WIDTH, 1, 0)
    ContentArea.Position = UDim2.new(0, SIDEBAR_WIDTH, 0, 0)
    ContentArea.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    ContentArea.Parent = ContentMain

    self.TabButtons = {}
    self.Pages = {}
    self.TabList = TabList
    self.ContentArea = ContentArea
    self.ScreenGui = ScreenGui

    return self
end

function SUFFIX:CreateTab(iconInput)
    local icon = iconInput or "rbxassetid://14456045412"

    local TabBtn = Instance.new("ImageButton")
    TabBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0, 34)
    TabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28)
    TabBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    
    if icon:find("rbxassetid://") or icon:find("rbxthumb://") then
        TabBtn.Image = icon
    else
        TabBtn.Image = "rbxassetid://14456045412"
    end
    
    TabBtn.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
    TabBtn.Parent = self.TabList

    local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    Corner.Parent = TabBtn

    -- Page Scrolling Frame
    local Page = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    Page.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    Page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Page.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Page.ScrollBarThickness = 3
    Page.Visible = false
    Page.Parent = self.ContentArea

    local PageLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    PageLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    PageLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
    PageLayout.Parent = Page

    local PagePadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    PagePadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10)
    PagePadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10)
    PagePadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)
    PagePadding.Parent = Page

    table.insert(self.TabButtons, TabBtn)
    table.insert(self.Pages, Page)

    if #self.Pages == 1 then
        Page.Visible = true
        TabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
        TabBtn.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end

    TabBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for _, p in ipairs(self.Pages) do p.Visible = false end
        for _, t in ipairs(self.TabButtons) do
            t.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28)
            t.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
        end
        Page.Visible = true
        TabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
        TabBtn.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end)

    local TabObj = {}

    function TabObj:CreateSection(sectionText)
        local SecLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        SecLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
        SecLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        SecLabel.Text = "  " .. sectionText
        SecLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 160)
        SecLabel.TextSize = 12
        SecLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        SecLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        SecLabel.Parent = Page
        return SecLabel
    end

    function TabObj:CreateButton(name, callback)
        local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        Btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
        Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28)
        Btn.Text = "  " .. name
        Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
        Btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        Btn.TextSize = 13
        Btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        Btn.Parent = Page

        local BtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        BtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
        BtnCorner.Parent = Btn

        Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if callback then pcall(callback) end
        end)
        return Btn
    end

    function TabObj:CreateToggle(name, defaultState, callback)
        local toggled = defaultState or false

        local ToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        ToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
        ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28)
        ToggleBtn.Text = "  " .. name
        ToggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
        ToggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        ToggleBtn.TextSize = 13
        ToggleBtn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        ToggleBtn.Parent = Page

        local ToggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        ToggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
        ToggleCorner.Parent = ToggleBtn

        local StatusIndicator = Instance.new("Frame")
        StatusIndicator.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12)
        StatusIndicator.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
        StatusIndicator.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0)
        StatusIndicator.BackgroundColor3 = toggled and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
        StatusIndicator.Parent = ToggleBtn

        local IndicatorCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        IndicatorCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        IndicatorCorner.Parent = StatusIndicator

        ToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            toggled = not toggled
            StatusIndicator.BackgroundColor3 = toggled and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
            if callback then pcall(function() callback(toggled) end) end
        end)

        return ToggleBtn
    end

    function TabObj:CreateLabel(text)
        local Lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        Lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
        Lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Lbl.Text = "  " .. text
        Lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
        Lbl.TextSize = 12
        Lbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        Lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        Lbl.Parent = Page
        return Lbl
    end

    return TabObj
end

function SUFFIX:Close(windowInstance)
    if windowInstance and windowInstance.ScreenGui then
        windowInstance.ScreenGui:Destroy()
    end
end

-- ================= EXAMPLE IMPLEMENTATION =================
local Window = SUFFIX:CreateWindow({
    Title = "SUFFIX-Ui"
})

-- Create Tabs with your asset IDs
local HomeTab = Window:CreateTab("rbxassetid://14456045412")
local CombatTab = Window:CreateTab("rbxassetid://4391741881")
local SettingsTab = Window:CreateTab("rbxassetid://134515081025675")

-- Populate Home Tab
HomeTab:CreateSection("Welcome")
HomeTab:CreateLabel("SUFFIX-Ui Library loaded successfully.")
HomeTab:CreateButton("Print Hello", function()
    print("Hello from SUFFIX-Ui!")
end)

-- Populate Combat Tab
CombatTab:CreateSection("Combat Cheats")
CombatTab:CreateToggle("Godmode", false, function(state)
    print("Godmode is now: " .. tostring(state))
end)
CombatTab:CreateToggle("Kill Aura", true, function(state)
    print("Kill Aura is now: " .. tostring(state))
end)

-- Populate Settings Tab
SettingsTab:CreateSection("Configuration")
SettingsTab:CreateButton("Unload UI", function()
    SUFFIX:Close(Window)
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local Config = {
	MenuKey = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,
	SpeedBoost = 60,
	MaxSpeedLimit = 400,
	TurnAssist = 40,
	Downforce = 50,
	Enabled = true
}

local Palette = {
	Base = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 16),
	Header = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 12),
	Surface = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 23),
	SurfaceHover = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 29),
	KeycapBg = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 29),
	KeycapBottom = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 10),
	Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(36, 36, 42),
	StrokeFocus = Color3.fromRGB(64, 64, 74),
	Accent = Color3.fromRGB(220, 48, 68),
	TextPrimary = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 244),
	TextSecondary = Color3.fromRGB(142, 142, 152),
	TextDim = Color3.fromRGB(88, 88, 98),
	Track = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 35)
}

local GuiParent = (gethui and gethui()) or CoreGui
if GuiParent:FindFirstChild("SoftBodySpeedGUI") then
	GuiParent.SoftBodySpeedGUI:Destroy()
end

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "SoftBodySpeedGUI"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
ScreenGui.Parent = GuiParent

local function Stroke(parent, color, thickness)
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Color = color or Palette.Stroke
	s.Thickness = thickness or 1
	s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	s.Parent = parent
	return s
end

local function Corner(parent, radius)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
	c.Parent = parent
	return c
end

local function Anim(obj, props, time)
	local info = TweenInfo.new(time or 0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local t = TweenService:Create(obj, info, props)
	t:Play()
	return t
end


local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"

local TitleList = Instance.new("UIListLayout")

TitleList.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center

TitleList.Parent = TitleGroup

local BrandTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")

BrandTitle.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
BrandTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1

local EditionSep = Instance.new("Frame")

EditionTitle.TextColor3 = Palette.Accent

EditionTitle.Parent = TitleGroup

local KeycapOuter = Instance.new("Frame")
KeycapOuter.Size = UDim2.new(0, 56, 0, 21)

Corner(KeycapOuter, 3)

local Container = Instance.new("Frame")
Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -48)
Container.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 44)
Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Container.Parent = MainFrame

local Layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
Layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 7)
Layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
Layout.Parent = Container

local Dragging = false
local DragStart, StartPos
local TargetPos = MainFrame.Position

TopBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		Dragging = true
		DragStart = input.Position
		StartPos = TargetPos
		Anim(MainStroke, { Color = Palette.StrokeFocus }, 0.1)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and Dragging then
		Dragging = false
		Anim(MainStroke, { Color = Palette.Stroke }, 0.15)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if Dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
		local delta = input.Position - DragStart
		TargetPos = UDim2.new(
			StartPos.X.Scale,
			StartPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			StartPos.Y.Scale,
			StartPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end)

local MenuOpen = true
local FullSize = UDim2.new(0, 332, 0, 288)
local ClosedSize = UDim2.new(0, 332, 0, 0)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
	if not gp and input.KeyCode == Config.MenuKey then
		Anim(KeycapTop, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0) }, 0.06)
		Anim(KeycapStroke, { Color = Palette.Accent }, 0.06)
		task.delay(0.1, function()
			Anim(KeycapTop, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -2) }, 0.1)
			Anim(KeycapStroke, { Color = Palette.StrokeFocus }, 0.1)
		end)

		MenuOpen = not MenuOpen
		if MenuOpen then
			MainFrame.Visible = true
			Anim(MainFrame, { Size = FullSize }, 0.16)
		else
			local t = Anim(MainFrame, { Size = ClosedSize }, 0.12)
			t.Completed:Connect(function()
				if not MenuOpen then
					MainFrame.Visible = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end)

local function CreateToggle(titleText, descText, defaultState, callback)
	local State = defaultState

	local Row = Instance.new("TextButton")

	Row.BackgroundColor3 = Palette.Surface
	Row.BorderSizePixel = 0

	TitleLbl.TextColor3 = State and Palette.TextPrimary or Palette.TextSecondary
	TitleLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	TitleLbl.TextSize = 12
	TitleLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	TitleLbl.Parent = Row

	local DescLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	DescLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -68, 0, 15)
	DescLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 11, 0, 24)
	DescLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	DescLbl.Text = descText
	DescLbl.TextColor3 = Palette.TextDim
	DescLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	DescLbl.TextSize = 10
	DescLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	DescLbl.Parent = Row

	local Track = Instance.new("Frame")
	Track.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 20)
	Track.Position = UDim2.new(1, -51, 0.5, -10)
	Track.BackgroundColor3 = State and Palette.Accent or Palette.Track
	Track.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Track.Parent = Row
	Corner(Track, 99)
	local TrackStroke = Stroke(Track, State and Palette.Accent or Palette.StrokeFocus, 1)

local function GetVehicleSeat()
	local Char = LocalPlayer.Character
	local Hum = Char and Char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if Hum and Hum.SeatPart and Hum.SeatPart:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
		return Hum.SeatPart
	end
	local CarsFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CrashTest") and Workspace.CrashTest:FindFirstChild("Cars")
	if CarsFolder then
		for _, car in ipairs(CarsFolder:GetChildren()) do
			if string.find(car.Name, LocalPlayer.Name) and car:FindFirstChild("DriverSeat") then
				return car.DriverSeat
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	if not Config.Enabled then return end

	local Seat = GetVehicleSeat()
	if not Seat then return end

	local Throttle = Seat.ThrottleFloat
	local Steer = Seat.SteerFloat
	local CurrentVel = Seat.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local Speed = CurrentVel.Magnitude

	if Config.SpeedBoost > 0 and math.abs(Throttle) > 0.05 then
		if Speed < Config.MaxSpeedLimit then
			local Forward = Seat.CFrame.LookVector * Throttle
			local Boost = Forward * (Config.SpeedBoost * dt * 2.2)
			local Down = Vector3.new(0, -Config.Downforce * dt * 0.5, 0)
			Seat.AssemblyLinearVelocity = CurrentVel + Boost + Down
		end
	end

	if Config.TurnAssist > 0 and math.abs(Steer) > 0.05 and Speed > 10 then
		local SpeedScale = math.clamp(Speed / 80, 0.7, 2.5)
		local TargetYaw = -Steer * (Config.TurnAssist * 0.04) * SpeedScale
		local AngVel = Seat.AssemblyAngularVelocity
		Seat.AssemblyAngularVelocity = AngVel:Lerp(Vector3.new(AngVel.X, TargetYaw, AngVel.Z), 0.35)

		local Dir = Seat.CFrame.LookVector * (Throttle >= 0 and 1 or -1)
		local FlatVel = Vector3.new(CurrentVel.X, 0, CurrentVel.Z)
		local AlignedVel = FlatVel:Lerp(Dir * FlatVel.Magnitude, 0.12)
		Seat.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(AlignedVel.X, CurrentVel.Y, AlignedVel.Z)
	end
end)

-- Minigame Highlighter (Flow solver + 50% overlay). Run client-side before opening a generator.
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
local ALPHA = 0.5 -- 50% transparency

------------------------------------------------------------ Flow solver
local function readPoint(v)
	if typeof(v) == "Vector2" then return v.X, v.Y end
	if type(v) == "table" then
		local x = v.x or v.X or v.Col or v.col or v[1]
		local y = v.y or v.Y or v.Row or v.row or v[2]
		return x, y
	end
end

local function normalize(pairsRaw, n)
	local list, minC, maxC = {}, math.huge, -math.huge
	for i, p in ipairs(pairsRaw) do
		local a = p.A or p.a or p.Start or p.From or p[1]
		local b = p.B or p.b or p.End or p.To or p[2]
		local ax, ay = readPoint(a)
		local bx, by = readPoint(b)
		if ax and ay and bx and by then
			for _, c in ipairs({ ax, ay, bx, by }) do
				minC, maxC = math.min(minC, c), math.max(maxC, c)
			end
			local col = p.Color or p.color
			list[#list + 1] = { a = { x = ax, y = ay }, b = { x = bx, y = by },
				color = typeof(col) == "Color3" and col or Color3.fromHSV((i - 1) / #pairsRaw, 0.85, 1) }
		end
	end
	local base = (minC >= 1 and maxC == n) and 1 or 0
	for _, p in ipairs(list) do
		p.a.x -= base; p.a.y -= base; p.b.x -= base; p.b.y -= base
	end
	return list
end

local function solve(n, pr, requireFull)
	local k, owner, paths, heads, done = #pr, {}, {}, {}, {}
	local filled, nodes = 2 * k, 0
	local dirs = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }
	for i, p in ipairs(pr) do
		owner[p.a.y * n + p.a.x] = i
		owner[p.b.y * n + p.b.x] = i
		paths[i] = { { x = p.a.x, y = p.a.y } }
		heads[i] = { x = p.a.x, y = p.a.y }
	end
	local function free(x, y) return x >= 0 and y >= 0 and x < n and y < n and owner[y * n + x] == nil end
	local function movesOf(i)
		local h, t, out = heads[i], pr[i].b, {}
		for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
			local x, y = h.x + d[1], h.y + d[2]
			if x == t.x and y == t.y then
				out[#out + 1] = { x = x, y = y, fin = true }
			elseif free(x, y) then
				out[#out + 1] = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
		return out
	end
	local function deadCell()
		for y = 0, n - 1 do
			for x = 0, n - 1 do
				if free(x, y) then
					local open = 0
					for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
						local nx, ny = x + d[1], y + d[2]
						if free(nx, ny) then open += 1
						else
							for i = 1, k do
								if not done[i] and ((heads[i].x == nx and heads[i].y == ny) or (pr[i].b.x == nx and pr[i].b.y == ny)) then
									open += 1
									break
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if open < (requireFull and 2 or 0) then return true end
				end
			end
		end
		return false
	end
	local function search()
		nodes += 1
		if nodes > 3e6 then return false end
		local best, bm
		for i = 1, k do
			if not done[i] then
				local m = movesOf(i)
				if #m == 0 then return false end
				if not bm or #m < #bm then best, bm = i, m end
			end
		end
		if not best then return (not requireFull) or filled == n * n end
		if requireFull and deadCell() then return false end
		for _, m in ipairs(bm) do
			if m.fin then
				done[best] = true
				paths[best][#paths[best] + 1] = { x = m.x, y = m.y }
				if search() then return true end
				table.remove(paths[best]); done[best] = nil
			else
				local old = heads[best]
				owner[m.y * n + m.x] = best; filled += 1
				heads[best] = { x = m.x, y = m.y }
				paths[best][#paths[best] + 1] = heads[best]
				if search() then return true end
				table.remove(paths[best]); heads[best] = old
				owner[m.y * n + m.x] = nil; filled -= 1
			end
		end
		return false
	end
	if search() then return paths end
end

------------------------------------------------------------ Overlay
local function findBoard(container)
	local best, area = nil, 0
	for _, d in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("GuiObject") then
			local s = d.AbsoluteSize
			if s.X > 50 and math.abs(s.X - s.Y) < 6 and s.X * s.Y > area and s.X * s.Y < container.AbsoluteSize.X * container.AbsoluteSize.Y * 1.01 then
				best, area = d, s.X * s.Y
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function drawFlow(gui, n, pr, paths)
	local board
	for _ = 1, 40 do
		board = findBoard(gui.Container)
		if board then break end
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
	if not board then return end
	local overlay = Instance.new("Frame")
	overlay.Name = "SolutionOverlay"
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	overlay.ZIndex = 100
	overlay.Parent = gui
	for i, path in ipairs(paths) do
		for _, c in ipairs(path) do
			local cell = Instance.new("Frame")
			cell.BorderSizePixel = 0
			cell.BackgroundColor3 = pr[i].color
			cell.BackgroundTransparency = ALPHA
			cell.ZIndex = 100
			cell.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1 / n, 1 / n)
			cell.Position = UDim2.fromScale(c.x / n, c.y / n)
			cell.Parent = overlay
		end
	end
	local conn
	conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not gui.Parent then conn:Disconnect() return end
		local p = board.AbsolutePosition - gui.AbsolutePosition
		overlay.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.X, p.Y)
		overlay.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(board.AbsoluteSize.X, board.AbsoluteSize.Y)
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------ Hook
local function activeGui()
	for _, g in ipairs(LP.PlayerGui:GetChildren()) do
		if g:FindFirstChild("Container") and not g:FindFirstChild("SolutionOverlay") then return g end
	end
end

local function hook(moduleName, onStarted)
	local ok, mod = pcall(function()
		return require(RS.Systems.Player.Game.Minigames[moduleName])
	end)
	if not ok then return warn("highlighter: can't require " .. moduleName) end
	local origSession = mod.Session
	rawset(mod, "Session", function(self, id, props)
		local s = origSession(self, id, props)
		local origStart = s.Start
		s.Start = function(me, ...)
			origStart(me, ...)
			task.spawn(function()
				local gui
				for _ = 1, 40 do gui = activeGui() if gui then break end task.wait(0.05) end
				if gui then onStarted(me, gui) end
			end)
		end
		return s
	end)
end

hook("FlowClientMinigame", function(s, gui)
	local P = s.Network.Properties
	local n = P:Get("GridSize")
	local pr, raw = {}, P:Get("Pairs")
	for i, p in ipairs(raw) do
		local function xy(idx) return { x = (idx - 1) % n, y = (idx - 1) // n } end
		pr[i] = { a = xy(p[1]), b = xy(p[2]), color = Color3.fromHSV((i - 1) / #raw, 0.85, 1) }
	end
	local paths = solve(n, pr, true) or solve(n, pr, false)
	if paths then drawFlow(gui, n, pr, paths) else warn("highlighter: no solution found") end
end)

------------------------------------------------------------ shared overlay
local function makeOverlay(gui, board, onFrame)
	local overlay = Instance.new("Frame")
	overlay.Name = "SolutionOverlay"
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	overlay.ZIndex = 100
	overlay.Parent = gui
	local conn
	conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not gui.Parent then conn:Disconnect() return end
		local p = board.AbsolutePosition - gui.AbsolutePosition
		overlay.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.X, p.Y)
		overlay.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(board.AbsoluteSize.X, board.AbsoluteSize.Y)
		if onFrame then onFrame(overlay.AbsoluteSize) end
	end)
	return overlay
end

local function waitBoard(gui)
	for _ = 1, 40 do
		local b = findBoard(gui.Container)
		if b then return b end
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------ Connect
local CB = require(RS.Modules.Minigames.ConnectBoard)
hook("ConnectClientMinigame", function(s, gui)
	local P = s.Network.Properties
	local blobs = P:Get("Blobs")
	local layout = CB.Layout(#blobs, P:Get("Along"))
	local cb = CB.new(blobs)
	local board = waitBoard(gui)
	if not board then return end
	local lines = {}
	local overlay = makeOverlay(gui, board, function(S)
		for _, l in ipairs(lines) do
			local a, b = l.a * S, l.b * S
			local d = b - a
			l.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d.Magnitude, 8)
			l.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((a.X + b.X) / 2, (a.Y + b.Y) / 2)
			l.f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(d.Y, d.X))
		end
	end)
	local function pos(i) -- side 1=top 2=right 3=bottom 4=left (guess, flip here if wrong)
		local l = layout[i]
		if l.Side == 1 then return Vector2.new(l.Along, 0)
		elseif l.Side == 2 then return Vector2.new(1, l.Along)
		elseif l.Side == 3 then return Vector2.new(l.Along, 1)
		else return Vector2.new(0, l.Along) end
	end
	for i = 1, #blobs do
		local m = cb:GetMate(i)
		if m and i < m then
			local c = typeof(blobs[i]) == "Color3" and blobs[i] or Color3.fromHSV((blobs[i] * 0.137) % 1, 0.85, 1)
			local f = Instance.new("Frame")
			f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			f.BorderSizePixel = 0
			f.BackgroundColor3 = c
			f.BackgroundTransparency = ALPHA
			f.ZIndex = 100
			f.Parent = overlay
			lines[#lines + 1] = { f = f, a = pos(i), b = pos(m) }
		end
	end
end)

------------------------------------------------------------ Lock
local LB = require(RS.Modules.Minigames.LockBoard)
hook("LockClientMinigame", function(s, gui)
	local P = s.Network.Properties
	local shadow = LB.new(P:Get("Config"))
	local function sync(st)
		if typeof(st) == "table" and typeof(st.Presses) == "number" and st.Presses >= shadow.State.Presses then
			shadow:Apply(st)
		end
	end
	sync(P:Get("State"))
	P:Connect("State", sync)
	local board = waitBoard(gui)
	if not board then return end
	local flash = Instance.new("Frame")
	flash.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	flash.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
	flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	flash.BorderSizePixel = 0
	flash.ZIndex = 100
	local dot = Instance.new("Frame") -- target marker (0 = up, clockwise; flip if wrong)
	dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16)
	dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
	dot.BackgroundTransparency = ALPHA
	dot.ZIndex = 101
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0); c.Parent = dot
	local overlay = makeOverlay(gui, board, function(S)
		local a = math.rad(shadow.State.Target)
		local r = S.X * 0.4
		dot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(S.X / 2 + math.sin(a) * r, S.Y / 2 - math.cos(a) * r)
		local on = shadow:IsOnTarget(shadow:AngleAt(workspace:GetServerTimeNow()))
		flash.BackgroundTransparency = on and ALPHA or 1
	end)
	flash.Parent = overlay
	dot.Parent = overlay
end)
print("Minigame highlighter loaded (Flow)")

-- Global Connection Tracker to prevent memory leaks
local EventConnections = {}
local function RegisterConnection(name, conn)
    -- Big O: O(1) hash map insertion
    if EventConnections[name] then
        pcall(function() EventConnections[name]:Disconnect() end)
    end
    EventConnections[name] = conn
end

local function DisconnectConnection(name)
    -- Big O: O(1) hash map deletion
    if EventConnections[name] then
        pcall(function() EventConnections[name]:Disconnect() end)
        EventConnections[name] = nil
    end
end

local function Notify(data)
    if not EmoteFlingConfig.NotificationsEnabled then return end
    if VaporLens and VaporLens.Notify then
        VaporLens:Notify(data)
    end
end

local function SaveConfig()
    -- Big O: O(n) for JSON encoding where n is the config size
    local config = {
        Armed = EmoteFlingConfig.Armed,
        AnimId = EmoteFlingConfig.AnimId,
        Speed = EmoteFlingConfig.Speed,
        UseCustomId = EmoteFlingConfig.UseCustomId,
        CustomId = EmoteFlingConfig.CustomId,
        NotificationsEnabled = EmoteFlingConfig.NotificationsEnabled,
        FloatingButtonsEnabled = EmoteFlingConfig.FloatingButtonsEnabled,
        FloatingButtonScale = EmoteFlingConfig.FloatingButtonScale,
        antiFallEnabled = EmoteFlingConfig.antiFallEnabled,
        godEnabled = EmoteFlingConfig.godEnabled,
        antiFlingEnabled = EmoteFlingConfig.antiFlingEnabled,
        noclipEnabled = EmoteFlingConfig.noclipEnabled,
        ToggleKey = (EmoteFlingConfig.ToggleKey and typeof(EmoteFlingConfig.ToggleKey) == "EnumItem") and EmoteFlingConfig.ToggleKey.Name or "K",
        QuickFireKey = (EmoteFlingConfig.QuickFireKey and typeof(EmoteFlingConfig.QuickFireKey) == "EnumItem") and EmoteFlingConfig.QuickFireKey.Name or nil,
    }

    local jsonStr = HttpService:JSONEncode(config)
    pcall(function() writefile(CONFIG_FILE, jsonStr) end)
end

local function LoadConfig()
    -- Big O: O(n) for JSON decoding
    local fileExists = false
    if type(isfile) == "function" then
        pcall(function() fileExists = isfile(CONFIG_FILE) end)
    else
        local ok, _ = pcall(function() return readfile(CONFIG_FILE) end)
        fileExists = ok
    end

    if not fileExists then
        SaveConfig()
        return false
    end

    local ok, content = pcall(function() return readfile(CONFIG_FILE) end)

    if ok and content and content ~= "" then
        local decodeOk, config = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(content) end)

        if decodeOk and type(config) == "table" then
            EmoteFlingConfig.Armed = config.Armed or false
            EmoteFlingConfig.AnimId = config.AnimId or "133566007754001"
            EmoteFlingConfig.Speed = config.Speed or 16
            EmoteFlingConfig.UseCustomId = config.UseCustomId or false
            EmoteFlingConfig.CustomId = config.CustomId or ""
            EmoteFlingConfig.NotificationsEnabled = config.NotificationsEnabled ~= false
            EmoteFlingConfig.FloatingButtonsEnabled = config.FloatingButtonsEnabled or false
            EmoteFlingConfig.antiFallEnabled = config.antiFallEnabled or false
            EmoteFlingConfig.godEnabled = config.godEnabled or false
            EmoteFlingConfig.antiFlingEnabled = config.antiFlingEnabled or false
            EmoteFlingConfig.noclipEnabled = config.noclipEnabled or false
            EmoteFlingConfig.FloatingButtonScale = math.clamp(tonumber(config.FloatingButtonScale) or 1.0, 0.5, 3.0)
             
            if config.ToggleKey then
                pcall(function() EmoteFlingConfig.ToggleKey = Enum.KeyCode[config.ToggleKey] end)
            end
            if config.QuickFireKey then
                pcall(function() EmoteFlingConfig.QuickFireKey = Enum.KeyCode[config.QuickFireKey] end)
            end
            
            return true
        end
    end
    
    SaveConfig()
    return false
end
